title: call for bids - u.s. embassy in uruguay
paragraphs: preventive maintenance services for the embassy’s building automation systems (bas) the u.s. embassy in montevideo, through the general services office (gso), procurement section, invites qualified, reliable, responsible, and responsive companies to submit a quotation for preventive maintenance services for the embassy’s building automation systems (bas) in montevideo, uruguay. the services include preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, adjustments, trend and alarm configuration, evaluation of the overall functionality of the systems, and other related activities, in accordance with the requirements set forth in the statement of work (sow). for details, please request the information to montevideoprocurement@state.gov submission deadline: september 3, 2026, no later than 3:30 pm. new deadline download important information here . quotation for event management service for 4 half day each conference event service, between the period from september 2026 to september 2027 to be coordinated with the embassy the u.s. embassy in montevideo, general services office (gso) contracting and procurement, seeks a company; qualified, reliable, responsible and responsive with sufficient resources and work experience to provide a quotation for event management service for 4 half day each conference event service, between the period from september 2026 to september 2027 to be coordinated with the embassy. for details, please request the information to montevideoprocurement@state.gov submission deadline: september 2, 2026, no later than 10:00 am. download important information here .
